text: The initiative has constructed 21 retention ponds at a cost of BND 80 million, significantly reducing flood-prone areas from 332 km² to 288 km². It addresses both inland flooding and coastal erosion along 57 km of coastline. The program includes comprehensive measures such as dredging and widening of major rivers, installation of water control gates, and enhancement of urban drainage systems.

metadata.solution_name: Government Flood Risk Reduction and Mitigation Initiatives in Brunei Darussalam (2020–2025)
